header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.7.0 (combat rework complete): 1) Elytra post-flight freeze fixed (stopGliding/stopFlying/repath/steering kick on end); guaranteed Mace combo with horizontal homing + up to 3 consecutive rebound-dive strikes; 2) Bow/Crossbow self-hit eliminated (2.2-block muzzle offset, projectile.shoot velocity vector, own-arrow threat filter, zero-velocity & close-proximity guard); 3) Crystal/Anchor blast-block timing fixed (offensive crystal placed or anchor charged FIRST, then front shield block placed right before detonation); 4) Anchor step-down crater -> low-ground entry -> feet obsidian + crystal combo, plus continuous anchor + front-block spam chain; 5) KB-sword airborne feet obsidian -> d-tap multi-crystal rapid detonation (pops 2+ totems); 6) Fixed normal/bare-hand melee hits not registering on SimBot (removed synthetic Resistance II stacking on SimulatedPlayer); 7) /bot hard enables all combat toggles at maximum strength by default; persistent debug logging (/pvpbot:debugdump) records all hurt/combo events.
